_doc: Read by engine/hooks/pre_tool_use.py. mcp: every MCP tool is blocked unless an entry's tool glob matches its full name (mcp__<server>__<tool>); list tools by exact name where possible. shell: commands matching an entry's regex pattern are blocked unless its conditions hold. Optional conditions on any entry: roles (["main"]: only the main session, i.e. calls without agent_id), job_types, states, gate (a valid token for the active job). The two mcp__ccd_turn__ entries are the desktop app's own task-list and next-step tools, for the main session only.
